description: Read one raw storage slot of a contract on Polygon PoS (eth_getStorageAt): the 32-byte word, as a number and, when it holds one, as an address. Slot is a decimal index or a 0x 32-byte key (mapping and proxy slots). Use to inspect contract state that has no getter, owners or implementation pointers; for proxies use polygon_proxy. A malformed address or slot is rejected with 400, uncharged. Example: address=0x3c499c542cEF5E3811e1192ce70d8cC03d5c3359. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

slot.description: Slot: a decimal index (0, 1, 2…) or a 0x 32-byte key

name: polygon_storage
title: Polygon storage slot read
